remarks:
Behind the rustic exterior of this 6 acre, 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home is an unexpectedly modern interior offering approximately 2,190 square feet of living space. Post-and-beam construction, exposed natural wood, hardwood flooring and unique architectural details create character throughout, while the open layout gives the home a comfortable, contemporary feel.

The gourmet kitchen is a standout, featuring a substantial center island, abundant workspace, modern cabinetry, swing-arm pot filler, stainless appliances and radiant floor heat for an extra touch of comfort during Western New York winters. The kitchen flows naturally into the dining and living spaces, making it an inviting place to cook, entertain and gather. First-floor laundry adds everyday convenience, while the property's private sauna provides your own place to unwind and recharge at home.

Then step outside, because that's where this property becomes even more interesting.

The property includes four substantial outbuildings—two 2-story barns and two large pole barns—all featuring metal roofs. Whether your needs involve equipment, vehicles, storage, hobbies, collections or workspace, there's room here to think bigger.

Add three-phase electric service and two separate electric meters, and you've got a property offering a level of versatility that's increasingly difficult to find.

For the buyer who has been saying, “I need more than just a house,” this may be exactly what you've been waiting for.

Modern living. Rustic character. Serious outbuilding space. And possibilities everywhere you look. This is not your typical Stafford property—and that's exactly the point. Showings and Negotiations begin Monday September 28th @ 4pm.
